intro: The Ignition Key is an essential control key carried by Supervisor Lugwizzle at the Venture Company's drilling operation in Sludge Fen. It is required to unlock the steering column and activate the controls of an advanced Venture Company shredder.

p: When Sputtervalve of Ratchet dispatched an operative to steal a proprietary Venture Company shredder from Sludge Fen, things did not go smoothly. The undercover pilot, Wizzlecrank, managed to slip into the machine's cockpit only to find its movement column completely locked down. To keep suspicious foremen from catching on, he feigned mechanical troubles while awaiting an adventurer to retrieve the necessary Ignition Key. The key remains held under lock and key by Supervisor Lugwizzle high atop the central oil derrick, controlling access to the machine's state-of-the-art arm, speed, and rotation mechanisms.
